enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move arm. Move leg. Remain asleep. Snore. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Take out spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Open dishwasher. Place bowl in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out underwear. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Pick up belt. Put on belt. Pick up phone. Pick up bag. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Clock in. Put on uniform. Wash hands. Check patient list. Go to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Assist with mobility. Update patient records. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Wash hands. Check patient vitals. Administer treatment. Talk to patient. Clean equipment. Clock out.
Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add vegetables. Add meat. Turn off cooker. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Open dishwasher. Place plate in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in air-conditioned room, watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on air conditioner. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on bed. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Press power button. Type on keyboard. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll screen. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Turn off air conditioner. Turn off light. Lie down.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet face. Pick up soap. Apply soap to face. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk from bathroom to bedroom. Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Walk to bed. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Move arm. Move leg. Turn to right side. Remain asleep.
